title.narrative: Comores - Projet de renforcement des capacités institutionnelles (PRCI)
Comoros - The Institutional Capacity Building Project (ICBP)

description.narrative: Le Projet de Renforcement des Capacités Institutionnelles (PRCI) a été conçu dans le but du renforcement des capacités institutionnelles et en particulier l’amélioration de la gestion des ressources publiques. En effet, capacités institutionnelles en matière d’administration, de gestion financière et de capacités de collecte, suivi et analyse de données ont été considérablement réduits avec les crises politiques et institutionnelles que les Comores traversent depuis plus qu’une décennie. Le projet vise à renforcer les capacités institutionnelles au niveau de l’Union des Comores ainsi qu’au niveau des trois (03) îles autonomes de Grande Comores, d’Anjouan et de Mohéli. Le coût total du projet est estimé à 5,26 millions d’UC dont 3,537 millions d’UC en devises et 1,722 millions d’UC en monnaie locale. Le PRCI s'articule autour de trois (03) composantes, à savoir: (i) l'appui au renforcement des Finances Publiques; (ii) l'appui au renforcement des capacités en planification et statistiques; et (iii) la gestion du projet.

The Institutional Capacity Building Project (ICBP) is designed for the purpose of institutional capacity building, particularly improvement of public resource management. Indeed, for more than a decade, the Union of the Comoros has experienced political and institutional crises that have considerably weakened its institutional capacity with respect to administration and financial management, data collection, monitoring and analysis. The aim of the project is to build institutional capacity of the Union the Comoros and the three autonomous islands (Grand Comoros, Anjouan and Moheli). The total project cost is estimated at UA 5.26 million, of which UA 3.537 million in foreign exchange and UA 1.722 million in local currency. The PRCI is structured around three (03) components, namely: (i) public finance support; (ii) support to planning and statistics capacity; and (iii) project management.

L’objectif de développement du projet proposé est d’améliorer la capacité des institutions du secteur public à fournir des services de qualité, en vue de contribuer à la réalisation des objectifs de développement du pays. L’objectif spécifique du projet est de renforcer les capacités institutionnelles en matière de gestion économique, financière et en particulier la gestion et le suivi des ressources publiques, l’élaboration, l’exécution et le suivi des politiques de réduction de la pauvreté.

The development objective of the proposed project is to strengthen the capacity of private sector institutions to provide quality services, with a view to contributing to the achievement of the country’s development goals. The specific project objective is to strengthen institutional capacity in terms of economic and financial management, especially public resource management and monitoring, as well as the design and implementation of poverty reduction policies.

Les bénéficiaires directs de l’appui sont: la direction générale du budget et du contrôle financier, la direction générale du trésor et de la comptabilité publique, les directions générales des impôts, les directions générales des douanes, la direction de la dette, la cellule des réformes économiques et financières, la commission de vérification des comptes, l’inspection générale des finances, le commissariat général au plan, la direction nationale des statistiques, les comptables dans les ministères clés ainsi que les directeurs administratifs et financiers. Au total c’est environ 300 cadres devraient directement bénéficier du projet.

The direct beneficiaries are: the Budget and Finance Control Department, the Treasury and Public Accounting Department, Taxation Department, the Customs Department, Debt Department, Economic and Financial Reforms Unit, the Audit Commission, General Inspectorate of Finance, General Planning Commission, National Statistics Department, and accountants in key ministries as well as directors of administration and finance. About 300 senior staff should directly benefit from the project.

target.value: 9 months of International Technical Assistance (ITA) and a national consultant (duration of 30 months) were recruited to support the national institute in charge of statistics in the preparation of price statistics.

actual.value: 10 months of ITA, and a national consultant, who was recruited for 30 months, supported the national institute in charge of statistics in the preparation of price statistics. The support helped to establish methodologies for the production of a renovated CPI and the HIPI.

Enhanced capacities of the General Planning Commission (CGP) for 2010-2014 PRGS monitoring

target.value: A national expert, recruited for 24 months, supported the CGP in 2010-2014 PRGS monitoring-evaluation. IT hardware and office equipment was delivered to the CGP. CGP premises are rehabilitated.

actual.value: A national expert supported the CGP for 48 months in 2010-2014 PRGS monitoring-evaluation. The 2010, 2011, 2012 and 2013 monitoring-evaluation reports were prepared.

title.narrative: Enhanced capacities for preparation of national accounts

target.value: 9 months of International Technical Assistance (ITA) and a national consultant, recruited for 30 months, supported the national institute in charge of statistics in the preparation of national accounts. The ERETES software for the preparation of national accounts is installed and is operational.

actual.value: ITA, which lasted 10 months, and a national consultant, who was recruited for 30 months, supported the national institute in charge of statistics in the preparation of national accounts. This support helped, in particular, to establish the methodology for preparation of national accounts in line with NAS 93.

target.value: The CSDRMS 2000+ software is installed and operational. At least 15 Debt Department officers receive IT training. 80 S/D of technical assistance in public debt management capacity building was provided.

actual.value: The CSDRMS 2000+ software is installed and operational. All Debt Department officers, including 6 women, received training in debt analysis and use of the CSDRMS 2000+ software (the Debt Department had 8 officers in the training).

title.narrative: Capacity building in the preparation of socio-economic statistics for Poverty Reduction and Growth Strategy (PRGS) monitoring-evaluation

target.value: Regular production of national accounts in line with NAS 93, Regular production of renovated CPI, and Regular production of monitoring-evaluation reports for the 2010-2014 PRGS.

actual.value: The methodology for the preparation of national accounts in line with NAS 93 is mastered by the staff of the National Institute of Statistics, Economic and Demographic Studies (INSEED).

title.narrative: Recent and available statistical data on employment, the informal sector and household expenditure

target.value: Conduct of statistical survey 1.2.3 with the support of a minimum of 30 P/D of International Technical Assistance (ITA)

actual.value: With 101 Staff/Day (S/D) of International Technical Assistance (ITA) support, statistical survey 1.2.3 was conducted. Recent statistical data on employment, the informal sector and household expenditure are available
